article_context: Body image after the instructions for receiving help at the resort, before the FAQ. It reinforces that guests delayed by a flight can still rest comfortably with their family at the hotel.
image_reading: A relaxed family of four shares breakfast in a hotel lounge: the parents sit on a sofa while two girls sit by a low table.
The mother already holds a cup; the table setting, breakfast food, and calm seated poses support a small, natural people motion.

models.positive_prompt: The seated woman slowly raises her cup a little toward herself, keeping a relaxed smile; fixed camera. By the final frames, she holds the cup comfortably at chest height while the family remains calmly gathered around breakfast.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the mother makes one measured lift of the cup from its initial low position toward a comfortable chest-height hold. The fixed wide framing keeps the family and breakfast table visible; the movement develops steadily and settles near the end without a new gesture.

models.positive_prompt: The woman gently lifts her cup into a relaxed chest-height hold, her warm expression unchanged; the family remains quietly together over breakfast. Fixed camera, ending with the cup held steady.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, use a soft continuous cup lift that begins promptly and travels evenly through most of the shot. Keep the camera fixed on the family grouping and let the motion ease into the visible final hold in the last moments.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the family breakfast. The woman smoothly raises her cup to a comfortable chest-height hold, maintaining her relaxed smile; end with the cup steady and the family still calmly gathered.
models.scene_plan: In four seconds, focus on the mother’s single, modest cup lift. It starts immediately, reaches the chest-height endpoint close to the end, and settles naturally while the wide composition continues to show the family’s calm hotel breakfast.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Even when travel plans are disrupted, the resort provides a calm, welcoming place where a family can continue their holiday comfortably.
structured_intent.primary_action: The seated mother gently lifts her cup.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The family remains relaxed, safe, and comfortably together at the resort.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The mother holds the cup steadily at a comfortable chest height while the family remains gathered around breakfast.
